system.description:
Built on Project FU's Sweetheart.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Inventory Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Source: League homebrew Sweetheart.)

SOCIALITE SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000302]{Eye of the Beholder}

Once per rest, ask one PC or significant NPC what they found attractive or admirable about you. Additionally, whenever you roll dice with a character who is currently Fond of you (has a positive Bond emotion toward you), you may reroll one of those dice once.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000303]{Fine Presentation} 【Max SL 5】

Write a list of your character's notable qualities (up to SL traits, chosen at creation or updated at level-up). When an NPC confirms they find one of those traits admirable, earn 1 FP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000304]{Double Edge}

Characters who help you gain +1 on their helping roll. Characters who attempt to harm or manipulate you also gain +1 on those rolls. Both bonuses apply to the same action when relevant.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000305]{Centre of Attention} 【Max SL 5】

Spend (SL × 5) MP. Until the end of the round, one creature of your choice must include you among its targets if it makes an area attack, or must target you if it makes a single-target attack. Alternatively, it may not target you at all — your choice, declared when you activate this.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000306]{Wavering Emotions} 【Max SL 3】

Spend 10 MP. Add one emotion (positive or negative, your choice) to any Bond — including a Bond another character holds toward an NPC, or a Bond that does not yet exist (creating a temporary Bond for the scene). This emotion lasts until the end of the scene.
